title: Builder composition is semantic, not Swing layout source
summary: Wire UI Builder v0.11 explicitly remains a fact editor for flow. Its composition artifacts use typed renderer hints such as GRID12/FLOW, region, order, span, rowSpan, alignment, viewport class and conditional placement facts; a Swing renderer interprets those facts without writing Swing-specific coordinates back into Builder.
invariants: Never compile Builder placement to absolute Swing pixel bounds.
GRID12 column/span/row/rowSpan/order/region are semantic renderer hints.
Conditional placement and journey admission remain authoritative compiled/server facts; Swing does not evaluate or invent business predicates.
Projection variants may change presentation while element-centric composition remains stable unless an exact projection-specific placement is explicitly authored.
procedure: Reuse existing JComponent objects when structural ordering changes so renderer-local edits/focus survive.
Treat Builder presentationClass/styleRole/materialRole as presentation hints only.

provenance.claim: GRID12/FLOW composition uses typed renderer hints and is not DOM/Swing authoring truth.

mapping.screen: authoritative view/screen hosted in stable desktop container
